title: AAPS 3.3.1.3 on Motorola Edge 50 Neo (Android 14): not able to connect to Omnipod Dash
symptom: After changing pods for the first time on a new Motorola Edge 50 Neo running AAPS 3.3.1.3, the phone cannot find or activate a new Omnipod Dash pod. Deactivating the old pod worked, but activation fails with a ScanException: Not found.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer states it is not an AAPS issue and that the error means Android didn't find the active pod. User speculation mentions possible similarity to Pixel issues on Android 15, but no cause is confirmed.
fix: A user suggests a workaround: ensure the old pod is at least a meter away, force-close AAPS and clear its cache (not storage), then disable and re-enable Bluetooth. This is reported to work for the user on a Pixel 9, but not confirmed for this issue.
evidence_quote: For me a workaround is to make sure the old pod is further away (at least a meter) and then I have to force-close aaps and clear cache
